children.text: Ahorātravratacaityasevānuśaṃsāvadāna
children.translated_text: <s>Ahorātravratacaityasevānuśaṃsāvadāna</s> (The Narrative of the Merits of the Day-and-Night Vow and Shrine Worship)

children.text: oṃ namo ratnatrayāya /
children.translated_text: <s>Oṃ</s> — Homage to the Three Jewels (<s>Ratnatraya</s>)!

children.text: śrīmad ratnatrayaṃ natvā tridhātubhuvanādhipam /
children.translated_text: Having bowed to the glorious Three Jewels (<s>Ratnatraya</s>), the lords of the three realms of existence,

children.text: ahorātravratakathāṃ vakṣye gurūpadeśataḥ || 1 ||
children.translated_text: I shall relate the narrative of the day-and-night vow (<s>ahorātravrata</s>), according to the instruction of the guru. (1)

children.text: kukkuṭārāmam āsīnam upaguptaṃ yatīśvaram /
children.translated_text: <s>Aśoka</s>, with palms joined in reverence, respectfully entreated

children.text: kṛtāñjalipuṭo 'śokaḥ prārthayad evam ādarāt || 2 ||
children.translated_text: the ascetic lord <s>Upagupta</s>, who was seated at the <s>Kukkuṭārāma</s> (Cock Monastery), in this manner: (2)

children.text: bhadanta śrotum icchāmi caityavratavidhiṃ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Venerable Sir, I wish to hear again the procedure of the shrine-vow (<s>caityavrata</s>),

children.text: ahorātravratasyāpi vidhiṃ puṇyāni sadguro || 3 ||
children.translated_text: and also the procedure and the merits of the day-and-night vow (<s>ahorātravrata</s>), O noble teacher. (3)

children.text: tad bhavān sadguruḥ śāstā lokapuṇyapravṛddhaye /
children.translated_text: 'Therefore, may the Venerable One, the noble teacher, the master, for the increase of the world's merit,

children.text: ahorātravratasyātra vidhim ādeṣṭum arhati || 4 ||
children.translated_text: deign to teach the procedure of the day-and-night vow (<s>ahorātravrata</s>). (4)'

children.text: iti tena narendreṇa prārthitaṃ sa sudhīr yatiḥ /
children.translated_text: Having heard the entreaty of that king of men, the wise ascetic,

children.text: śrutvā taṃ nṛpam ālokya punar evam upādiśat || 5 ||
children.translated_text: looking upon that king, taught him thus in return: (5)

children.text: śṛṇu sādhu mahārāja yathā me guruṇoditam /
children.translated_text: 'Listen well, O great king, as it was spoken by my teacher;

children.text: tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śrutvā caivaṃ samācara || 6 ||
children.translated_text: so shall I declare it to you — and having heard it, practice accordingly. (6)

children.text: purā sa bhagavāñ chāstā śākyasiṃho jagadguruḥ /
children.translated_text: 'In the past, the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the Teacher, the Lion of the <s>Śākyas</s> (<s>Śākyasiṃha</s>), the World-Teacher,

children.text: śrāvakair bhikṣubhiḥ sārdhaṃ cailakaiś cāpy upāsakaiḥ || 7 ||
children.translated_text: together with disciples (<s>śrāvakas</s>), monks (<s>bhikṣus</s>), white-robed [lay followers], and male lay devotees (<s>upāsakas</s>), (7)

children.text: bhikṣuṇībhiḥ suśīlābhir bodhisattvagaṇair api /
children.translated_text: together with nuns (<s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>) of good conduct and hosts of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>,

children.text: vihāre jetakāraṇye vyaharat saugatāśrame || 8 ||
children.translated_text: was dwelling in the <s>Jetavana</s> monastery, the hermitage of the <s>Sugata</s>. (8)

children.text: tadā sa bhagavān buddho lokānāṃ puṇyavṛddhaye /
children.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Buddha</s>, for the increase of merit of all beings,

children.text: sabhāmadhye samāsīno dharmam ādeṣṭum ārabhat || 9 ||
children.translated_text: seated in the midst of the assembly, began to teach the <s>Dharma</s>. (9)

children.text: tadā sarve 'marendrādilokapālā maharddhikāḥ /
children.translated_text: Then all the great world-protectors (<s>Lokapālas</s>), led by the lord of the immortals (<s>Amarendra</s>), endowed with great supernatural powers,

children.text: tat saddharmāmṛtaṃ pātuṃ śraddhayā samupāgatāḥ || 10 ||
children.translated_text: came with faith to drink that nectar of the true <s>Dharma</s> (<s>saddharmāmṛta</s>). (10)

children.text: brahmādibrāhmaṇāś cāpi maharṣayas tapasvinaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> and other <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, great sages (<s>maharṣis</s>), ascetics,

children.text: catvāraś ca mahārājāḥ sasainyaparicārakāḥ || 11 ||
children.translated_text: and the Four Great Kings (<s>Caturmahārājas</s>) with their armies and attendants, (11)

children.text: daityendrā nāgarājāś ca yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ /
children.translated_text: lords of the <s>Daityas</s>, kings of the <s>Nāgas</s>, <s>Yakṣas</s>, <s>Gandharvas</s>, <s>Kinnaras</s>,

children.text: siddhā vidyādharāḥ sādhyā grahāś ca vasavas tathā || 12 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Siddhas</s>, <s>Vidyādharas</s>, <s>Sādhyas</s>, planets (<s>Grahas</s>), and the <s>Vasus</s>, (12)

children.text: rākṣasāś ca mahāvirā garuḍāś ca mahoragāḥ /
children.translated_text: mighty <s>Rākṣasas</s>, <s>Garuḍas</s>, and great serpents (<s>Mahoragas</s>),

children.text: yogino yatayaś cāpi rājānaḥ kṣātriyā api || 13 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Yogins</s>, ascetics, and also kings and <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, (13)

children.text: amātyā mantriṇaś cāpi vaiśyā rājakumārakāḥ /
children.translated_text: ministers, counselors, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, princes,

children.text: śreṣṭhino dhaninaḥ śūdrāḥ sārthavāhā māhājanāḥ || 14 ||
children.translated_text: guild-masters, the wealthy, <s>Śūdras</s>, caravan-leaders, and great merchants, (14)

children.text: vaṇijaḥ śilpinaś cāpi paurā janapadās tathā /
children.translated_text: traders, artisans, townspeople, and country-folk,

children.text: grāmyāḥ kārvaṭikāś cāpi tathānyadeśavāsinaḥ || 15 ||
children.translated_text: villagers, market-town dwellers, and also those from other lands — (15)

children.text: sarve te samupāgatya buddhaṃ taṃ śṛīghanaṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: all of them, having approached that <s>Buddha</s>, the embodiment of glory, with joy,

children.text: satkṛtya śraddhayābhyarcya kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāny api || 16 ||
children.translated_text: having honored him with faith and reverence, and having performed circumambulation, (16)

children.text: kṛtāñjalipuṭā natvā niṛīkṣya saṃpramoditāḥ /
children.translated_text: with palms joined, having bowed, having gazed [upon him] with delight,

children.text: tat saddharmāmṛtaṃ pātum upatasthuḥ samāhitāḥ || 17 ||
children.translated_text: they stood attentively, ready to drink that nectar of the true <s>Dharma</s>. (17)

children.text: tadāsanāt samutthāya subhūtiḥ sthaviro yatiḥ /
children.translated_text: Then the elder <s>Subhūti</s>, the ascetic, rising from his seat,

children.text: udvahann uttarāsaṅgaṃ jānubhyāṃ bhuvi saṃsthitaḥ || 18 ||
children.translated_text: lifting his upper robe (<s>uttarāsaṅga</s>), knelt upon the ground on both knees, (18)

children.text: kṛtāñjalipuṭo natvā bhagavantaṃ jagadgurum /
children.translated_text: and with palms joined, having bowed to the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the World-Teacher,

children.text: śrīghanaṃ taṃ samālokya prārthayad evam ādarāt || 19 ||
children.translated_text: gazing upon that embodiment of glory, he respectfully entreated thus: (19)

children.text: bhagavan nātha sarvajña vijānīyād bhavān guruḥ /
children.translated_text: 'O <s>Bhagavān</s>, Protector, Omniscient One — may the Venerable Teacher know:

children.text: sarvalokā ime śāstur dharmaṃ śrotuṃ samāsthitāḥ || 20 ||
children.translated_text: all these beings, O Teacher, are assembled to hear the <s>Dharma</s>. (20)

children.text: tad atra bhuvane khyātam ahorātravrataṃ kadā /
children.translated_text: 'The day-and-night vow (<s>ahorātravrata</s>) which is renowned in this world —

children.text: pravartate tad ākhyāhi tadvidhiṃ ca kathaṃ prabho || 21 ||
children.translated_text: when does it take place? Declare that, and its procedure as well, O Lord! (21)'

children.text: iti tenārhatā pṛṣṭe bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: When thus asked by that <s>Arhat</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the lord of sages,

children.text: tāṃ sabhāṃ taṃ subhūtiṃ ca samālokyaivam abravīt || 22 ||
children.translated_text: looking upon that assembly and upon <s>Subhūti</s>, spoke thus: (22)

children.text: sādhu śṛṇu subhūte tvaṃ sarvasattvahitārthabhṛt /
children.translated_text: 'Listen well, <s>Subhūti</s>, you who bear the welfare of all beings;

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ puṇyaṃ vidhiṃ ca kathyate mayā || 23 ||
children.translated_text: the meritorious day-and-night vow and its procedure are being told by me. (23)

children.text: purā pūrvavidehe 'bhūt khyātā gandhavatī purī /
children.translated_text: 'In the past, in <s>Pūrvavideha</s>, there was a famous city called <s>Gandhavatī</s>;

children.text: tasyāṃ rājā mahāvijña indrapṣṭābhidhaḥ prabhuḥ || 24 ||
children.translated_text: in it [ruled] a great and wise king named <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s>, a lord. (24)

children.text: so 'ntaḥpure samānīya vasubandhuṃ jinātmajam /
children.translated_text: 'He, having brought <s>Vasubandhu</s>, a son of the <s>Jina</s>, into the inner palace,

children.text: sabhāyāṃ svāsane sthāpya satkṛtya śraddhayārcayat || 25 ||
children.translated_text: having seated him upon the royal seat in the assembly, honored and worshipped him with faith. (25)

children.text: tataḥ sa bhūpatī rājā utthāya samupāśritaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then that king, the lord of the earth, rising and approaching [him],

children.text: kṛtāñjaliḥ praṇatvainaṃ prārthayad evam ādarāt || 26 ||
children.translated_text: with palms joined, having bowed, respectfully entreated thus: (26)

children.text: bhadanta yad ime lokā asaddharmābhimāninaḥ /
children.translated_text: '"Venerable Sir, since these beings are proud of false doctrines (<s>asaddharma</s>),

children.text: tad eṣāṃ mānaghātāya saddharmaṃ samupādiśa || 27 ||
children.translated_text: therefore, for the destruction of their pride, teach them the true <s>Dharma</s>. (27)

children.text: yac chrutvaiva tv ime sarve saddharmapratibodhitāḥ /
children.translated_text: '"Having heard which, may all these beings, awakened to the true <s>Dharma</s>,

children.text: sarvapāpavinirmuktā bhaveyur bodhilābhinaḥ || 28 ||
children.translated_text: become freed from all sins and attain <s>Bodhi</s> (awakening). (28)"'

children.text: iti rājñārthitaṃ śrutvā vasubandhuḥ sa ātmavit /
children.translated_text: Having heard the king's entreaty, <s>Vasubandhu</s>, that knower of the Self,

children.text: indrapṛṣṭaṃ mahīndraṃ taṃ samālokyaivam abravīt || 29 ||
children.translated_text: looking upon King <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s>, the lord of the earth, spoke thus: (29)

children.text: śṛṇu sādhu mahārājā tava puṇyapravṛddhaye /
children.translated_text: 'Listen well, O great king — for the increase of your merit,

children.text: sarvasattvahitārthaṃ tad ahorātramahāvratam || 30 ||
children.translated_text: and for the welfare of all beings, [I shall teach] the great day-and-night vow (<s>ahorātramahāvrata</s>). (30)

children.text: yathā mayā śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ vipaśyinā prabhāṣitam /
children.translated_text: 'As it was formerly heard by me, as proclaimed by [the <s>Buddha</s>] <s>Vipaśyin</s>,

children.text: mahatpuṇyānuśaṃsā ca tadvidhiś ca pracakṣyate || 31 ||
children.translated_text: [so] shall the great meritorious rewards and the procedure thereof be declared. (31)

children.text: saṃsāre 'tra mahat puṇyaṃ prāptum icchanti ye narāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Those persons who in this <s>saṃsāra</s> wish to obtain great merit

children.text: caritavyam ahorātravrataṃ taiḥ śraddhayā mudā || 32 ||
children.translated_text: should undertake the day-and-night vow with faith and joy. (32)

children.text: bhaktyā caranti ye martyā ahorātravrataṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: 'Those mortals who with devotion joyfully practice the day-and-night vow —

children.text: te sarve vimalātmānaḥ pariśuddhatrimaṇḍalāḥ || 33 ||
children.translated_text: they all become pure in self, purified in the three spheres (<s>trimaṇḍala</s>). (33)

children.text: bodhicittaṃ samāsādya caritvā bodhicārikām /
children.translated_text: 'Having generated <s>bodhicitta</s> (the mind of awakening) and practicing the conduct of <s>Bodhi</s>,

children.text: sarvasattvahitaṃ kṛtvā pūrya pāramitāḥ kramāt || 34 ||
children.translated_text: having done what benefits all beings, gradually fulfilling the <s>pāramitās</s> (perfections), (34)

children.text: sarvakleśagaṇāñ jitvā sarvamāragaṇān api /
children.translated_text: 'having conquered all the hosts of <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions) and all the armies of <s>Māra</s>,

children.text: samyagbodhiṃ samāsādya bhaveyuḥ sugatā dhruvam || 35 ||
children.translated_text: having attained perfect awakening (<s>samyagbodhi</s>), they will surely become <s>Sugatas</s> (Well-Gone Ones). (35)

children.text: atītaiś ca jinaiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtvaitad vratam uttamam /
children.translated_text: 'By all the past <s>Jinas</s> (Victors), having performed this supreme vow,

children.text: sarvamāragaṇāñ jitvā saṃbodhiḥ sādhitā khalu || 36 ||
children.translated_text: having conquered all the armies of <s>Māra</s>, <s>Saṃbodhi</s> (perfect awakening) was indeed accomplished. (36)

children.text: vartamānaiś ca saṃbuddhaiḥ sarvair etad vrataṃ kṛtam /
children.translated_text: 'And by all the present <s>Sambuddhas</s> (Fully Awakened Ones), this vow was practiced;

children.text: etatpuṇyānubhāvair hi saṃbodhiḥ sādhitā drutam || 37 ||
children.translated_text: by the power of its merit, <s>Saṃbodhi</s> was swiftly accomplished. (37)

children.text: tathā cānāgataiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtvā caitad vrataṃ varam /
children.translated_text: 'Likewise by all those [<s>Buddhas</s>] yet to come, having performed this supreme vow,

children.text: etatpuṇyavipākais tu prāpsyate bodhir uttamā || 38 ||
children.translated_text: by the ripening of its merit, the highest <s>Bodhi</s> will be attained. (38)

children.text: tathānye bodhisattvāś ca saṃbodhivratacārakāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'And other <s>Bodhisattvas</s> also, practitioners of the <s>Saṃbodhi</s>-vow,

children.text: etad vratavaraṃ dhṛtvā caranti bodhisaṃvaram || 39 ||
children.translated_text: upholding this supreme vow, practice the <s>Bodhi</s>-discipline (<s>bodhisaṃvara</s>). (39)

children.text: tathā sarve 'marendrāś ca kṛtvā caitad vrataṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: 'Likewise all the lords of the immortals (<s>Amarendras</s>), having joyfully performed this vow,

children.text: devalokādhināthās te bhavanti bodhibhāginaḥ || 40 ||
children.translated_text: becoming lords of the heavenly realms (<s>Devaloka</s>), they partake of <s>Bodhi</s>. (40)

children.text: evaṃ sarve mahāsattvā ṛṣayo munayo 'pi ca /
children.translated_text: 'Thus all great beings, sages (<s>ṛṣis</s>), and silent sages (<s>munis</s>) as well,

children.text: etad vratavaraṃ kṛtvā bhavanti brahmacāriṇaḥ || 41 ||
children.translated_text: having performed this supreme vow, become practitioners of the holy life (<s>brahmacārin</s>). (41)

children.text: evaṃ ye ye narāś cāpi caranty etad vrataṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: 'Thus, whichever persons joyfully practice this vow,

children.text: te te sarve 'pi tatpuṇyair bhavanti bodhibhāginaḥ || 42 ||
children.translated_text: all of them, by the merit thereof, partake of <s>Bodhi</s>. (42)

children.text: ye cāpy etad vrataṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutvāpi cānumoditāḥ /
children.translated_text: 'And those who, having seen or even heard of this vow, rejoice in it,

children.text: prasīdanti tathā te 'pi tatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuvanti hi || 43 ||
children.translated_text: they likewise become serene and obtain that merit. (43)

children.text: etatpuṇyānubhāvena naiva gacchanti durgatim /
children.translated_text: 'By the power of that merit, they never go to the lower realms (<s>durgati</s>);

children.text: sarvadā saśubhaṃ saukhyaṃ bhuktvā yānti jinālayam || 44 ||
children.translated_text: having always enjoyed auspicious happiness, they go to the abode of the <s>Jina</s> (Victor). (44)

children.text: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saddharmasukhavāñchibhiḥ /
ahorātravrataṃ bhaktyā caritavyaṃ naraiḥ sadā // Avc_45 /
children.translated_text: should always devotedly practice the day-and-night vow. (45)

children.text: ahorātravratotpannapuṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate /
children.translated_text: 'The count of the merit arising from the day-and-night vow does not exist [i.e., is incalculable];

children.text: aprameyam asaṃkhyeyam iti buddhaiḥ prakathyate || 46 ||
children.translated_text: it is immeasurable and innumerable — thus is it declared by the <s>Buddhas</s>. (46)
'Therefore, with every effort, those who desire the happiness of the true <s>Dharma</s>

children.text: sarvair api munīndrais tat saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate /
children.translated_text: 'Even by all the lords of sages, its measure cannot be reckoned;

children.text: mayātra śakyam ekena tatpuṇyaṃ gaṇituṃ katham || 47 ||
children.translated_text: how then could I alone calculate that merit? (47)

children.text: yasya puṇyānubhāvena mahānti pātakāny api /
children.translated_text: 'By the power of whose merit, even great transgressions

children.text: nirdahya pariśuddhātmā tatkṣaṇād yāti sadgatim || 48 ||
children.translated_text: are burnt away, and the purified self instantly goes to a good destination. (48)

children.text: yathābhilaṣitaṃ kāryaṃ sādhayitvā hy avighnataḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Having accomplished every desired aim without obstruction,

children.text: sarvadā satsukhaṃ bhuktvā saṃyānty ante jinālayam || 49 ||
children.translated_text: having always enjoyed true happiness, they finally go to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>. (49)

children.text: iti matvā mahatpuṇyam ahorātravrataṃ varam /
children.translated_text: 'Thus, understanding the great merit of the supreme day-and-night vow,

children.text: dharmārthakāmamokṣāptyai caritavyaṃ sadā naraiḥ || 50 ||
children.translated_text: it should always be practiced by people for the attainment of <s>Dharma</s>, <s>Artha</s> (wealth), <s>Kāma</s> (desire), and <s>Mokṣa</s> (liberation). (50)

children.text: tathā cet te mahatpuṇyam ihāmutra śubhaṃ sadā /
children.translated_text: 'Thus, if [you practice it], great merit and auspiciousness [will come] here and hereafter, always;

children.text: kramād bodhivrataṃ prāpya bodhisattvo bhaved dhruvam || 51 ||
children.translated_text: gradually attaining the awakening-vow, one will surely become a <s>Bodhisattva</s>. (51)

children.text: kramāt kleśān vinirjitya saṃsārasukhanandinaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Gradually conquering the <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions) and [overcoming] delight in the pleasures of <s>saṃsāra</s>,

children.text: jitvā māragaṇān sarvān saṃbuddhapadam āpnuyāḥ || 52 ||
children.translated_text: having vanquished all the armies of <s>Māra</s>, you shall attain the state of a <s>Sambuddha</s> (Fully Awakened One). (52)'

children.text: iti tena samākhyātaṃ dhīmatā vasubandhunā /
children.translated_text: Thus was it declared by the wise <s>Vasubandhu</s>;

children.text: śrutvaivaṃ sumahat puṇyam indrapṛṣṭo mumoda saḥ || 53 ||
children.translated_text: having heard of such supremely great merit, King <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s> rejoiced. (53)

children.text: tataḥ sa indrapṛṣṭākhyo mahārājo 'numoditaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then that great king named <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s>, filled with joy,

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ kartuṃ cārayituṃ samaicchata || 54 ||
children.translated_text: wished to perform and to cause [others] to perform the day-and-night vow. (54)

children.text: tataḥ sa nṛpa utthāya sāñjaliḥ samupācaran /
children.translated_text: Then that king, rising, with palms joined, approaching respectfully,

children.text: vasubandhuṃ tam ānatvā prārthayad evam ādarāt || 55 ||
children.translated_text: having bowed to <s>Vasubandhu</s>, entreated him reverently thus: (55)

children.text: bhadanta bhavatādiṣṭam ahorātravratodbhavam /
children.translated_text: Venerable one, you have taught the merits arising from the <s>ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night observance);

children.text: mahat puṇyaṃ niśamyāhaṃ kartum icchāmi sāṃpratam || 56 ||
children.translated_text: having heard of such great merit, I now wish to perform it. (56)

children.text: tasmāt tadvidhim ādeṣṭum arhasi me jagaddhite /
children.translated_text: Therefore, please instruct me in its procedure for the welfare of the world;

children.text: sarvathāhaṃ cariṣyāmi cariṣyanti prajā api || 57 ||
children.translated_text: I shall practice it in every way, and so shall my subjects. (57)

children.text: tad atra sarvasattvānāṃ hitāya puṇyasiddhaye /
children.translated_text: Thus, for the benefit of all beings and for the attainment of merit,

children.text: ahorātravratasyaivaṃ vidhim ādeṣṭum arhasi || 58 ||
children.translated_text: please instruct the procedure of the <s>ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night observance). (58)

children.text: iti tena narendreṇa prārthitaṃ sa mahāmatiḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus entreated by that king, the great-minded one,

children.text: vasubandhur niśamyaivaṃ indrapṛṣṭaṃ tam abravīt || 59 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vasubandhu</s>, having heard <s>Indra</s>'s question, spoke to him as follows: (59)

children.text: śṛṇu rājan yathākhyātaṃ munīndreṇa vipaśyinā /
children.translated_text: Listen, O king, as it was taught by <s>Vipaśyin</s>, the lord of sages,

children.text: tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi vratarājavidhiṃ kramāt || 60 ||
children.translated_text: so shall I expound to you the procedure of this king of observances, step by step. (60)

children.text: svayaṃbhūcaityabhūkṣetre vihāre sugatāśrame /
children.translated_text: At a self-arisen <s>caitya</s> (stūpa), a sacred field, a <s>vihāra</s> (monastery), an abode of the <s>Sugata</s> (Buddha),

children.text: puṇyakṣetre nadītīre saṃgame saritāṃ tathā || 61 ||
children.translated_text: at a meritorious site, a riverbank, or at the confluence of rivers; (61)

children.text: tīrthe samudratīre ca hradatīre sarastaṭe /
children.translated_text: at a <s>tīrtha</s> (pilgrimage ford), at the seashore, at the edge of a lake, on the bank of a pond,

children.text: udyāne parvate 'raṇye vivikte vana-āśrame || 62 ||
children.translated_text: in a garden, on a mountain, in a forest, in a secluded woodland hermitage; (62)

children.text: caityālaye śubhe sthāne prāsāde mandire gṛhe /
children.translated_text: in a <s>caitya</s> shrine, an auspicious place, a palace, a temple, or a house,

children.text: evam anyatra bhūdeśe śuddhasthāne manorame || 63 ||
children.translated_text: or likewise in any other region of land that is a pure and delightful place — (63)

children.text: eteṣu pariśuddheṣu yatrepsite viśodhite /
children.translated_text: in whichever of these pure and desired places, having cleansed it,

children.text: dharmaśālāṃ vidhāyādau mṛdgomayair vilepayet || 64 ||
children.translated_text: one should first establish a <s>dharmaśālā</s> (hall of dharma) and anoint it with clay and cow-dung. (64)

children.text: caturdhvajān pratiṣṭhāpya vitanuyād vitānakam /
children.translated_text: Having erected four banners, one should spread a canopy,

children.text: puṣpamālādibhiś citrair duṣyaiḥ paṭṭaiś ca maṇḍayet || 65 ||
children.translated_text: and adorn it with colorful flower garlands and the like, with silken cloths and fine fabrics. (65)

[Editorial note: Manuscript E adds a verse in the margin as follows: One should anoint it with cow's milk and the five gems and powdered stone; and one should hang directional garlands and directional splendors upon the <s>Jina</s>-shrine. (65*)]

children.text: tatra vajrī śubhācāraḥ pariśuddhatrimaṇḍalaḥ /
children.translated_text: There the <s>vajrī</s> (vajra-master), of virtuous conduct, with the three <s>maṇḍalas</s> (of body, speech, and mind) purified,

children.text: maṇḍalaṃ vartayed ramyaṃ dharmadhātor yathāvidhi || 66 ||
children.translated_text: should draw a beautiful <s>maṇḍala</s> of the <s>dharmadhātu</s> (realm of dharma) according to the proper rite. (66)

children.text: tatas tan maṇḍalaṃ vajrī pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi /
children.translated_text: Then the <s>vajrī</s>, having consecrated that <s>maṇḍala</s> according to the proper rite,

children.text: vratināṃ saṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā vratārambhaṃ prakārayet || 67 ||
children.translated_text: and having assembled the <s>vratins</s> (observants), should commence the observance. (67)

children.text: śuklapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ bhojanānte dinātyaye /
children.translated_text: On the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, after the meal and at the close of day,

children.text: dantādidhāvanaṃ kṛtvā mukhādiṃ pariśodhayet || 68 ||
children.translated_text: having cleaned the teeth and so forth, one should purify the mouth and the rest. (68)

children.text: caturdaśyāṃ prabhāte ca tīrthe snātvā vratī sudhīḥ /
children.translated_text: On the fourteenth day, at dawn, having bathed at a <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford), the wise <s>vratin</s> (observant),

children.text: śucivastrāvṛto bhadraśīlaḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 69 ||
children.translated_text: clad in clean garments, of auspicious conduct, endowed with faith — (69)

children.text: madhyāhne maṇḍalaṃ caityaṃ pañcabhir upahārakaiḥ /
children.translated_text: at midday, should worship the <s>maṇḍala</s> and the <s>caitya</s> with the five offerings,

children.text: yathāvidhi samabhyarcya praṇāmaṃ saṃprakārayet || 70 ||
children.translated_text: and having duly venerated them, should perform prostrations. (70)

children.text: tato yāme tṛīye 'hnaḥ kārayed vratapālaṇam /
nirāmiṣair viśuddhānnaiḥ snānaṃ ca kārayet tataḥ || 71 ||/
children.translated_text: and should then bathe with pure, meatless food-offerings. (71)
Then in the third watch of the day, one should carry out the observance of the <s>vrata</s>,

children.text: tato rātrimukhe caityaṃ maṇḍalaṃ ca samarcayet /
children.translated_text: Then at the onset of night, one should worship the <s>caitya</s> and the <s>maṇḍala</s>,

children.text: dīpamālāḥ samujjvālya dharmaṃ ca śrāvayed vratīn || 72 ||
children.translated_text: and lighting rows of lamps, should teach the <s>Dharma</s> to the <s>vratins</s> (observants). (72)

children.text: pūrṇamāsyāṃ prabhāte tu snātvā śuddhāmbarāvṛtāḥ /
children.translated_text: On the full-moon day, at dawn, having bathed, clad in clean garments,

children.text: śodhitapañcagavyena kuryuś cāṅgaviśodhanam || 73 ||
children.translated_text: they should perform bodily purification with purified <s>pañcagavya</s> (five cow-products). (73)

children.text: tato dattvārgham ādau te sūryāya vratinas tathā /
children.translated_text: Then, first offering <s>arghya</s> (water-offering) to <s>Sūrya</s> (the Sun), the <s>vratins</s>,

children.text: gurave ca pradāyārghaṃ sthitvā svasvāsane kramāt || 74 ||
children.translated_text: and also presenting <s>arghya</s> to the <s>guru</s> (teacher), should sit in their respective seats in order. (74)

children.text: pūjāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi śodhayeyur yathāvidhi /
children.translated_text: They should purify all the articles of worship according to the proper rite;

children.text: tatrādau vratisaṃghaḥ sa vajrasattvaṃ samarcayet || 75 ||
children.translated_text: there, first, the assembly of <s>vratins</s> should worship <s>Vajrasattva</s>. (75)

children.text: tato ratnatrayaṃ caiva saṃpūjayed yathāvidhi /
children.translated_text: Then they should duly worship the <s>Triratna</s> (Three Jewels),

children.text: teṣāṃ ca śaraṇaṃ gatvā praṇamed racitāñjaliḥ || 76 ||
children.translated_text: and having taken refuge in them, should bow with palms joined. (76)

children.text: trisamādhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhyātvātmani jineśvaram /
children.translated_text: Then, having performed the three <s>samādhis</s>, meditating on the lord of <s>Jinas</s> within oneself,

children.text: āvāhayet puraḥ śrīmaddharmadhātuṃ maheśvaram || 77 ||
children.translated_text: one should invoke before oneself the glorious <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, the great lord. (77)

children.text: tatpādārghaṃ tato dadyāt tataś cācamanārghakam /
children.translated_text: Then one should offer the foot-<s>arghya</s> (water for the feet), and then the <s>ācamana-arghya</s> (sipping water),

children.text: prokṣaṇārghaṃ tato dattvā maṇḍale saṃniveśayet || 78 ||
children.translated_text: and then, having offered the <s>prokṣaṇa-arghya</s> (sprinkling water), one should seat [the deity] upon the <s>maṇḍala</s>. (78)

children.text: tataḥ pūjopahārais taṃ maṇḍalaṃ sagaṇaṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: Then, with offerings of worship, that <s>maṇḍala</s> together with its retinue, joyfully,

children.text: yathāvidhi samabhyarcya taddhṛnmantraṃ sudhīr japet || 79 ||
children.translated_text: having duly venerated it, the wise one should recite the heart-<s>mantra</s> thereof. (79)

children.text: {E adds here:
children.translated_text: [Editorial note: Manuscript E adds here:

children.text: tataḥ stotraṃ paṭhet /
children.translated_text: Then one should recite the hymn:

children.text: dharmadhātumayaṃ caityaṃ sarvākārasvarūpiṇam /
children.translated_text: The <s>caitya</s> made of <s>dharmadhātu</s>, embodying all forms,

children.text: ālayaṃ sarvabuddhānāṃ vāgīśvaraṃ namāmy aham //
children.translated_text: the abode of all <s>Buddhas</s> — I bow to <s>Vāgīśvara</s> (Lord of Speech).

children.text: jinajasakaladhātuṃ puṇyakṣetre kṛtārtham /
children.translated_text: The complete <s>dhātu</s> (relic/element) of the <s>Jina</s>, established in the meritorious field,

children.text: praviṇajanasukhārthaṃ sevitārthaṃ pradattam //
children.translated_text: given for the benefit and comfort of the wise, to be reverenced —

children.text: praṇamataṃ munirājaṃ aṃjaliṣṭhaṃ pradhānam /
children.translated_text: I bow to the chief among sage-kings, with palms joined,

children.text: jitasakalabhayārthaṃ lokanāthaṃ maheśam //}
children.translated_text: the great lord, protector of the world, who has conquered all fears.]

children.text: tataḥ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu toṣayed racitāñjaliḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, having recited the hymn, one should please [the deity] with palms joined;

children.text: pāpānāṃ deśanāṃ kuryāt thatā puṇyānumodanām || 80 ||
children.translated_text: one should make confession of sins and also rejoice in merit. (80)

children.text: pradakṣiṇāny ataḥ kuryāt saṃgītaiś ca mahotsavam /
children.translated_text: Then one should perform <s>pradakṣiṇās</s> (circumambulations), and celebrate a great festival with songs;

children.text: aṣṭāṅgapraṇatiṃ kṛtvā prārthayed bodhisaṃvaram /
children.translated_text: having performed the <s>aṣṭāṅgapraṇati</s> (eight-limbed prostration), one should aspire to the <s>bodhisaṃvara</s> (bodhisattva vow);

children.text: tataḥ kṣamārthanāṃ kṛtvā tanmaṇḍalaṃ visarjayet || 81 ||
children.translated_text: then, having made a request for forgiveness, one should dismiss that <s>maṇḍala</s>. (81)

children.text: yathā pūjā kṛtā tatra maṇḍale vidhivat tathā /
children.translated_text: Just as the worship was performed there in the <s>maṇḍala</s> according to the rite, so

children.text: caityabimbaṃ samabhyarcya prārthayed evam ādarāt || 82 ||
children.translated_text: one should worship the <s>caitya</s> image and pray with devotion as follows: (82)

children.text: tathā sarvatra caityeṣu kuryāt pūjādikaṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: Likewise at all <s>caityas</s>, one should joyfully perform worship and the rest,

children.text: saṃgītisahitaiḥ stotraiḥ kuryād evaṃ mahotsavam || 83 ||
children.translated_text: and with hymns accompanied by songs, one should celebrate a great festival. (83)

children.text: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāny eva nidrālāsyaṃ vihāya ca /
children.translated_text: Having performed <s>pradakṣiṇās</s> (circumambulations), and casting aside sleep and laziness,

children.text: mudā jāgaraṇaṃ kurvann ahorātraṃ vrataṃ caret || 84 ||
children.translated_text: one should joyfully keep vigil and observe the <s>vrata</s> for the full day and night. (84)

children.text: catuḥsaṃdhyaṃ tathā snātvā caityasevāṃ samācaret /
children.translated_text: Bathing at the four <s>saṃdhyās</s> (junctures of the day), one should perform <s>caityasevā</s> (stūpa worship);

children.text: duṣṭajātir na ca spṛśyā sparśite snānam ācaret || 85 ||
children.translated_text: one should not touch one of impure birth, and if touched, one should bathe. (85)

children.text: viśrāmaṃ naiva kuryāc ca khedaṃ cittena vā vratī /
children.translated_text: The <s>vratin</s> should take no rest, nor should the mind feel weariness;

children.text: caityadhyānasamādhāno japan stotraṃ paṭhaṃś caret || 86 ||
children.translated_text: absorbed in meditation on the <s>caitya</s>, one should recite <s>japa</s> and chant hymns throughout. (86)

children.text: nṛtyagītamahotsāhair nānāvādyaiḥ sanṛtyakaiḥ /
children.translated_text: With great enthusiasm for dance and song, with various musical instruments and dances,

children.text: hāhākāraiḥ samullāsaiḥ pracārayen mahotsavam || 87 ||
children.translated_text: with joyful exclamations and exultations, one should carry out the great festival. (87)

children.text: evaṃ pūrṇam ahorātram aviśrāntaṃ vrataṃ caret /
children.translated_text: Thus one should observe the <s>vrata</s> for the entire day and night without rest;

children.text: tataḥ prātas tathā snātvā maṇḍalaṃ caityam arcayet || 88 ||
children.translated_text: then in the morning, having bathed, one should worship the <s>maṇḍala</s> and the <s>caitya</s>. (88)

children.text: tataś chatraṃ patākāś ca sindūrapātrayā saha /
children.translated_text: Then one should raise an umbrella and banners together with a vermillion vessel,

children.text: salājākṣatapuṣpāṃś ca prārohayet mahotsavaiḥ || 89 ||
children.translated_text: and should hoist parched rice, unbroken grains, and flowers with great festivity. (89)

children.text: yajñaṃ kuryāt tathā vajrī baliṃ dadyād yathāvidhi /
children.translated_text: The <s>vajrī</s> (vajra-master) should then perform a <s>yajña</s> (fire-offering) and give <s>bali</s> (ritual offering) according to the rite,

children.text: abhiṣekaṃ tato dattvā pañcasūtraghaṭaṃ kramāt || 90 ||
children.translated_text: and then bestow <s>abhiṣeka</s> (consecration) with the five-thread water-vessel in proper order. (90)

children.text: sāśīrvādaṃ vratibhyo 'pi dadyād vajrī samāhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>vajrī</s>, with concentration, should also give blessings to the <s>vratins</s>;

children.text: tataḥ kṣamārthanāṃ kṛtvā maṇḍalaṃ tad visarjayet || 91 ||
children.translated_text: then, having made a request for forgiveness, one should dismiss that <s>maṇḍala</s>. (91)

children.text: tatas te vratinaḥ sarve vajrācāryaṃ guruṃ yatīn /
children.translated_text: Then all those <s>vratins</s> should worship the <s>vajrācārya</s> (vajra-teacher), the <s>guru</s>, and the ascetics,

children.text: abhyarcya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā toṣayeyuḥ praṇamya ca || 92 ||
children.translated_text: and having offered <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (honorarium), they should please and bow to them. (92)

children.text: tatas tadraja ādāya tīrthe nāgān samarcya ca /
children.translated_text: Then, taking the dust of that [<s>maṇḍala</s>], and worshipping the <s>nāgas</s> at the <s>tīrtha</s>,

children.text: pravāhayet tato gehaṃ prāyāyān maṅgalotsavaiḥ || 93 ||
children.translated_text: one should cast it into the water; then one should proceed home with auspicious festivities. (93)

children.text: tatra tanmaṇḍalasthānaṃ tīrthāmbunābhiṣiñcayet /
children.translated_text: There, at the site of that <s>maṇḍala</s>, one should sprinkle it with water from the <s>tīrtha</s>;

children.text: tatas te vratinaḥ sarve kuryus tadvratapālaṇam || 94 ||
children.translated_text: then all the <s>vratins</s> should observe the completion of that <s>vrata</s>. (94)

children.text: tatas tanmaṇḍalasthāne vajrācāryo yathāvidhi /
children.translated_text: Then at the site of that <s>maṇḍala</s>, the <s>vajrācārya</s> (vajra-teacher), according to the rite,

children.text: kumārīṃ pūjayitvā tāṃ devīṃ bhojyaiḥ pratoṣayet || 95 ||
children.translated_text: having worshipped a <s>kumārī</s> (maiden), should please that goddess with food-offerings. (95)

children.text: gaṇacakraṃ tato 'bhyarcya bhojanaiḥ saṃpratoṣayet /
children.translated_text: Then, having venerated the <s>gaṇacakra</s> (tantric feast-circle), one should gratify [all] with food;

children.text: vratinaḥ sādhakāṃś cāpi janān sarvāṃś ca toṣayet || 96 ||
children.translated_text: one should please the <s>vratins</s>, the <s>sādhakas</s> (practitioners), and all the people. (96)

children.text: evaṃ caranti ye martyā ahorātravrataṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: Those mortals who thus joyfully perform the <s>ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night observance),

children.text: te bhavanti mahāsattvā bodhisattvāḥ śubhāśayāḥ || 97 ||
children.translated_text: they become great beings, <s>Bodhisattvas</s> of noble intent. (97)

children.text: durgatiṃ te na gacchanti sadā gacchanti sadgatim /
children.translated_text: They do not go to the lower realms, but always go to the happy destinies;

children.text: bhuktvā dharmasukhotsāhaṃ saṃprayānti jinālayam || 98 ||
children.translated_text: having enjoyed the joy and zeal of the <s>Dharma</s>, they proceed to the abode of the <s>Jinas</s>. (98)

children.text: evaṃ vipaśyinā śāstrā samākhyātaṃ śrutaṃ mayā /
children.translated_text: Thus it was taught by the teacher <s>Vipaśyin</s>, and I have heard it;

children.text: bhūyaḥ śṛṇu mahārāja tatphalāni viśeṣataḥ || 99 ||
children.translated_text: hear further, O great king, its fruits in particular. (99)

children.text: pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcasugandhitoyair ye snāpayantīha jinendracaityam /
children.translated_text: Those who bathe a <s>caitya</s> of the lord of <s>Jinas</s> with the five nectars and the five fragrant waters,

children.text: mandākinīdivyasugandhitoye snātvāmarais te satataṃ ramante || 100 ||
children.translated_text: they always delight, bathing in the divine, fragrant waters of the <s>Mandākinī</s>, among the immortals. (100)

[Editorial note: Manuscript B has the following additional verse here: Those who offer <s>arghya</s> (water-offering) to a <s>caitya</s> with the five nectars, the five fragrant gems, <s>dūrvā</s> grass, unbroken grains, flowers, parched rice, and water — they obtain a great treasure here. (100*)]

children.text: kurvanti caitye jalamaṇḍalaṃ ye supiṣṭavāsena tathā manuṣyāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those people who make a water-<s>maṇḍala</s> at a <s>caitya</s> with finely ground fragrant paste,

children.text: te hemavarṇā nṛpavaṃśajātāḥ samṛddhimantaḥ subhagā bhavanti || 101 ||
children.translated_text: they become golden-hued, born in royal lineages, prosperous and fortunate. (101)

children.text: sugandhadhūpaṃ jinacaityabimbe ye dhūpayanti pratimodayantaḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who offer fragrant incense to the image of a <s>Jina</s>-<s>caitya</s>, rejoicing,

children.text: sugandhadehāḥ surasaṃghavandyās te śuddhacittā manujā bhavanti || 102 ||
children.translated_text: they become fragrant-bodied, praised by the assembly of gods, and pure-minded among humans. (102)

children.text: ye pañcagandhair anulepayanti saṃbuddhacaityaṃ manujāḥ prasannāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those people who, with faith, anoint a <s>caitya</s> of the <s>Saṃbuddha</s> (Fully Awakened One) with the five fragrances,

children.text: saugandhitāṅgā baladīptimantas te saṃbhavante paramārthalokāḥ || 103 ||
children.translated_text: they are born with fragrant bodies, possessing strength and radiance, in the highest realm. (103)

children.text: yajñopavītaṃ vararaṅgitaṃ ca sucīvarāṇi pradadanti caitye /
children.translated_text: Those who offer the sacred thread, fine colored cloths, and excellent garments at a <s>caitya</s>

children.text: te divyavastrāvṛtasaumyadehāḥ sarvārthasaṃpadbharitā bhavanti || 104 ||
children.translated_text: Their bodies wrapped in divine garments, graceful, they become filled with the attainment of all aims. (104)

children.text: ye sarvapuṣpair varagandhavadbhir abhyarcayanti pratinamya caityam /
children.translated_text: Those who worship a <s>caitya</s> (shrine) with all kinds of flowers, fragrant and excellent, bowing down —

children.text: nairogiṇas te sucirāyuṣaḥ syuḥ saubhāgyavantaḥ suviśālavaṃśāḥ || 105 ||
children.translated_text: they become free from disease, of very long life, fortunate, and of very extensive lineage. (105)

children.text: ye cāpi caityaṃ parimaṇḍayanti sragbhiḥ supuṣpai racitābhir evam /
children.translated_text: And those who adorn a <s>caitya</s> with garlands, well-fashioned from the finest flowers —

children.text: te bhāgyavantaḥ paribhūṣitāṅgā devā bhavanti prathitā nṛpāś ca || 106 ||
children.translated_text: they, fortunate ones with ornamented bodies, become gods of renown, and kings as well. (106)

children.text: ye dīpamālā racayanti caitye te ratnasaṃpatparipūrṇakoṣāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who arrange rows of lamps at a <s>caitya</s> — their treasuries become filled with jeweled wealth;

children.text: netrābhirāmāḥ sudṛśo bhavanti te jñānadīpāhatamohajālāḥ || 107 ||
children.translated_text: they become beautiful-eyed and clear-sighted, with the net of delusion destroyed by the lamp of knowledge. (107)

children.text: {A has two additional verses here
maitryā yaḥ saha kiṃkaraiḥ smararipuṃ nirjitya vajrāsane
children.translated_text: He who, together with his servants, with loving-kindness, having conquered the enemy of desire (<s>Smara</s>) on the diamond seat (<s>vajrāsana</s>),

children.text: kleśārīn api yo durantaviṣayān antaścarān durjanān /
children.translated_text: and who [conquered] the enemies of the afflictions (<s>kleśa</s>), those wicked inner foes of boundless sense-objects,

children.text: skandhārātim api prasahya sugato mṛtyuṃ ca niḥsvo 'vaśaḥ
children.translated_text: and who, the <s>Sugata</s>, having overcome even the enemy of the aggregates (<s>skandha</s>) and death itself, possessionless and free,

children.text: prāptaḥ sarvarasāgrabhogavaśitāṃ kṣīrodanāḍhaukanāt // Avc_107* //
children.translated_text: attained mastery over the highest enjoyment of all essences, from the nourishment of the milk-ocean. (107*)
{Manuscript A has two additional verses here:

children.text:
sauvarṇaraupyavidhadhātujamṛnmayaṃ vā
śālyodanaiḥ suparipūrṇasupiṇḍapātram /
bhaktyā dadāti sugatālayacaityabimbe
syāt tasya puṇyam asamaṃ phalam aprameyam // Avc_107** //}
children.translated_text:
Whether of gold, silver, mineral ore, or clay —
whoever with devotion offers a well-filled alms-bowl of rice
to the image of a <s>caitya</s>, the abode of the <s>Sugata</s>,
for that person the merit and fruit will be incomparable and immeasurable. (107**)}

children.text: ye caityabimbe surasaṃ praṇītaṃ naivedyam agraṃ pradadanti bhogyam /
children.translated_text: Those who offer to the <s>caitya</s> image a delicious, excellent, and enjoyable food-offering —

children.text: te lokaśreṣṭhā balakīrtiyuktā nṛpā bhavanti prathitānubhāvāḥ || 108 ||
children.translated_text: they become the best in the world, endowed with strength and fame, kings of celebrated power. (108)

children.text: ye cāpi caitye phalapattramūlaskandhādikaṃ vā pradadanti bhaktyā /
children.translated_text: And those who with devotion offer fruits, leaves, roots, trunks, and the like at a <s>caitya</s> —

children.text: nīrogiṇas te susamṛddhimanto yatheṣṭabhogyāḥ sukhino bhavanti || 109 ||
children.translated_text: they become free from disease, very prosperous, enjoying whatever they desire, and happy. (109)

children.text: bhaiṣajyam evaṃ pradadanti ye ca saṃbuddhacaitye manujāḥ prasannāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those faithful people who likewise offer medicine at a <s>caitya</s> of the fully awakened one —

children.text: snigdhānanās te nṛpatīśvarāś ca sauvaṃavarṇā nirujo bhavanti || 110 ||
children.translated_text: they, with kindly faces, become sovereign kings, of golden complexion, and free from disease. (110)

children.text:
{B, which had vs. ii noted above here, adds another verse,

....................................................... ye /
tasmai dadanti satataṃ jinapuṃgavāya

children.translated_text:
{Manuscript B, which had verse ii noted above here, adds another verse:
'The best buffalo-milk preparation mixed with ghee ... [lacuna] ... those who ...
who always offer to that [caitya] ...'

children.text: tāmbūlapūgādirasāyanāni ye caityabimbe pariḍhaukayanti /
children.translated_text: Those who offer betel, areca nut, and other elixirs at the <s>caitya</s> image —

children.text: te bhūmipālāḥ subhagā bhavanti divyāṅganānetramanoharāsyāḥ || 111 ||
children.translated_text: they become fortunate rulers of the earth, with faces captivating as the eyes of divine women. (111)

children.text:
{A and B have the following additional verse here.
kāntāpāṇisarojapattravidhṛtāṃ sadvarṇagandhojjvalāṃ
svādusparśasukhāṃ surāsurapure yad devavṛndārakaiḥ /
bhāsvatkāñcanabhājaneṣu nihitām aśnanti divyāṃ sudhāṃ
tad buddhapramukhāryasaṃghaviṣaye nyastānnadānāt phalam // Avc_111* //}
children.translated_text:
{Manuscripts A and B have the following additional verse here:
'[A drink] held in the lotus-hand of a beloved, brilliant with fine color and fragrance,
sweet to the touch and delightful, which in the city of gods and <s>Asuras</s>, by the chief gods,
in shining golden vessels ...'

children.text: ye caityabimbe pariśuddharaṅgān dhvajān vicitrān adhiropayanti /
children.translated_text: Those who hoist upon the <s>caitya</s> image banners of various pure colors —

children.text: mahīśvarās te jitaduṣṭasaṃghā dhanyā bhavanti prathitapratāpāḥ || 112 ||
children.translated_text: they become lords of the earth, having conquered hostile armies, blessed, of celebrated valor. (112)

children.text: uccair vitanvanti vitānam ārād ye caityabimbe manujāḥ prasannāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those faithful people who spread canopies high above the <s>caitya</s> image —

children.text: devādhipās te manujādhipāś ca dhanyā bhavanti prathitarddhimantaḥ || 113 ||
children.translated_text: they become lords of gods and lords of men, blessed, of celebrated supernatural powers. (113)

children.text: ye cāpi caitye manujā vicitrāḥ śuddhāḥ patākā avalambayanti /
children.translated_text: And those people who hang various pure pennants at a <s>caitya</s> —

children.text: te śrīsametā divi bhūtale ca nāthā bhavanti tridaśābhimānyāḥ || 114 ||
children.translated_text: they, endowed with <s>Śrī</s> (fortune), become lords in heaven and on earth, esteemed by the Thirty-three gods. (114)

children.text: chattraṃ suvarṇaṃ maṇibhir vicitraṃ paṭṭaiś ca siktaiḥ kusumaiḥ kṛtaṃ ca /
children.translated_text: A golden parasol, adorned with jewels, with silks and sprinkled flowers —

children.text: ye caityabimbe manujāḥ prasannā māṅgalyavādyair adhirohayanti || 115 ||
children.translated_text: those faithful people who raise it upon the <s>caitya</s> image with auspicious music — (115)

children.text: te dharmapālāḥ śubhakīrtiyuktā lakṣmyālayāḥ śrīguṇasaukhyavantaḥ /
children.translated_text: they become protectors of the <s>Dharma</s>, endowed with auspicious fame, abodes of <s>Lakṣmī</s>, possessed of the happiness of <s>Śrī</s> and virtue,

children.text: devādhirājā manujādhipāś ca saṃbodhicaryābhiratā bhavanti || 116 ||
children.translated_text: supreme lords of gods and rulers of men, delighting in the practice of awakening (<s>saṃbodhicaryā</s>). (116)

children.text: saṃgītavādyaiḥ sumanojñaśabdaiḥ śaṅkhādimāṅgalyamahānurāvaiḥ /
children.translated_text: With song and music of most pleasing sounds, with conches and other great auspicious instruments,

children.text: vīṇādibhir vaṃśamanojñaghoṣair mahotsavaṃ ye vitaranti caitye || 117 ||
children.translated_text: with <s>vīṇās</s> and flutes of delightful melody — those who spread a great festival at a <s>caitya</s> — (117)

children.text: te divyakarṇāḥ sumanojñavākyāḥ saundaryarūpāḥ pariśuddhacittāḥ /
children.translated_text: they become possessed of divine hearing and most pleasing speech, of beautiful form and purified mind,

children.text: maharddhimantaḥ sugatābhibhaktā martyāmarendrāḥ satataṃ bhavanti || 118 ||
children.translated_text: of great supernatural power, devoted to the <s>Sugata</s>, constantly [reborn as] lords among mortals and immortals. (118)

children.text: nṛtyaiḥ sulāsyaiḥ sumanojñabhāvair ye caityabimbaṃ sarasā bhajanti /
children.translated_text: Those who with feeling worship the <s>caitya</s> image with dances, graceful movements, and most pleasing expressions —

children.text: te pāpaduṣṭagraharogamuktāḥ puṇyā guṇārthānugatā bhavanti || 119 ||
children.translated_text: they, freed from evil, malicious planets, and disease, become meritorious, endowed with virtues and wealth. (119)

children.text: ye cāpi duṣṭān abhikheṭayanto rakṣanti caityaṃ satataṃ manuṣyāḥ /
children.translated_text: And those people who constantly protect a <s>caitya</s>, driving away the wicked —

children.text: te bhāgyavanto nirujāḥ suvaṃśāḥ saukhyaṃ prabhuktvā prasaranti svargam || 120 ||
children.translated_text: they, fortunate, free from disease, of good lineage, having enjoyed happiness, proceed to heaven. (120)

children.text: sadūrvakundākṣatalājakādi prākṣipya caityaṃ praṇamanti ye ca /
children.translated_text: Those who, having cast <s>dūrvā</s> grass, jasmine buds, <s>akṣata</s> (unbroken rice), and parched grain upon a <s>caitya</s>, bow down —

children.text: vidyādhipās te susamṛddhimanto gacchanti cānte sugatālaye 'pi || 121 ||
children.translated_text: they become masters of knowledge, very prosperous, and in the end go to the abode of the <s>Sugata</s>. (121)

children.text: ye vajramuktādiviśuddharatnaṃ hemādisaddravyavarāṣṭadhātūn /
children.translated_text: Those who [offer] diamonds, pearls, and other pure gems, gold and other fine substances, and the excellent eight minerals —

children.text: ye caityabimbe sarasā manuṣyāḥ śraddhānuraktā upaḍhaukayanti || 122 ||
children.translated_text: those faithful and devoted people who with feeling present them at the <s>caitya</s> image — (122)

children.text: pūrṇendriyāḥ pūrṇamanorathās te nirnaṣṭaśokāḥ subhagāḥ suvaṃśaḥ /
children.translated_text: they become possessed of full faculties and fulfilled desires, free from sorrow, fortunate, of good lineage,

children.text: dharmārthakāmāḥ suguṇābhirāmāḥ saṃbuddhamārgābhigatā bhavanti || 123 ||
children.translated_text: attaining <s>Dharma</s>, wealth, and pleasure, delighting in good qualities, and having entered the path of the fully awakened one. (123)

children.text: ye śuddhacittāḥ stutibhiḥ sugītair bhajanti caityaṃ manujāḥ prasannāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those faithful people who with purified minds worship a <s>caitya</s> with praises and beautiful songs —

children.text: dharmārthakāmābhimatarddhimanto bhavanti nāthā divi bhūtale te || 124 ||
children.translated_text: they become lords in heaven and on earth, endowed with the desired supernatural powers of <s>Dharma</s>, wealth, and pleasure. (124)

children.text: ye 'ṣṭābhir aṅgaiḥ praṇamanti caityaṃ śraddhāprasannāḥ śaraṇaṃ prayātāḥ /
children.translated_text: Those who bow to a <s>caitya</s> with the eight limbs [touching the ground], faithful and devoted, having gone for refuge —

children.text: bhūpādhipās te varasaptaratnair yuktāḥ sudhīrāḥ kṛtino bhavanti || 125 ||
children.translated_text: they become lords of the earth, endowed with the excellent seven jewels, wise, steadfast, and accomplished. (125)

children.text: pradakṣiṇīkṛtya mudā prasannā ye caityabimbaṃ praṇatā bhramanti /
children.translated_text: Those who, having circumambulated the <s>caitya</s> image with joy and devotion, wander about bowing —

children.text: suvarṇavarṇāḥ suviśālavaṃśāḥ pūjyā nṛpāṇām api te bhavanti || 126 ||
children.translated_text: they become golden-complexioned, of very extensive lineage, worthy of worship even by kings. (126)

children.text: śuddhāśmasaṃkṣārasugandhitoyaiś caityaṃ mudā ye 'bhyanulepayanti /
children.translated_text: Those who joyfully anoint a <s>caitya</s> with pure limestone, <s>kṣāra</s> (alkali), and fragrant waters —

children.text: nīrogaśokāḥ susamṛddhimanto dīrghāyuṣas te subhagā bhavanti || 127 ||
children.translated_text: they become free from disease and sorrow, very prosperous, long-lived, and fortunate. (127)

children.text: caityāṅganaṃ ye pariśodhayanti nirmālyam uddhṛtya ca mārjayanti /
children.translated_text: Those who clean the grounds of a <s>caitya</s>, removing the withered offerings and sweeping —

children.text: te hemavarṇāḥ pariśuddhacittā dharmābhiraktāḥ sudṛśo bhavanti || 128 ||
children.translated_text: they become golden-complexioned, of purified mind, devoted to the <s>Dharma</s>, and clear-sighted. (128)

children.text: ālasyenāpi ca stūpe karoti yaḥ pradakṣiṇām /
children.translated_text: Even one who out of laziness performs a circumambulation at a <s>stūpa</s> —

children.text: pade pade suvarṇaikakarṣadānaphalaṃ labhet || 129 ||
children.translated_text: at each step he obtains the fruit of giving one <s>karṣa</s> (measure) of gold. (129)

children.text: gandhapuṣpādibhir viprair arcanīyaṃ jinālayam /
children.translated_text: The abode of the <s>Jina</s> (Conqueror) should be worshipped by <s>Brahmins</s> with incense, flowers, and the like;

children.text: chattrāvarohaṇaṃ caitye kartavyaṃ kṣatriyair api || 130 ||
children.translated_text: the lowering of a parasol at a <s>caitya</s> should be performed by <s>Kṣatriyas</s> as well. (130)

children.text: dhvajāvaropaṇaṃ vaiśyaiḥ kṛtyaṃ patākayā saha /
children.translated_text: The hoisting of banners together with pennants is the duty of <s>Vaiśyas</s>;

children.text: naivedyam eva śūdrais tu dātavyaṃ caityapuṃgave || 131 ||
children.translated_text: food-offerings should be given by <s>Śūdras</s> at the supreme <s>caitya</s>. (131)

children.text: anyair vihīnajātībhir nārcanīyo jinālayaḥ /
children.translated_text: By others of lower castes, the abode of the <s>Jina</s> should not be worshipped

children.text: dhūpadīpādibhir naiva pūjanīyo na cānyathā || 132 ||
children.translated_text: with incense, lamps, and the like — it should not be worshipped thus, nor otherwise. (132)

children.text: mūlaskandhapattraphalastambaśasyādibhis tathā /
children.translated_text: With roots, trunks, leaves, fruits, stalks, grains, and the like,

children.text: dhānyādivrīhibhiś caivam auṣadhībhī rasāyanaiḥ || 133 ||
children.translated_text: with paddy, rice, and likewise with herbs and elixirs, (133)

children.text: tathā vādyaiḥ sugītaiś ca nṛtyaiś cāpi mahotsavaiḥ /
children.translated_text: and likewise with music, beautiful songs, dances, and great festivals,

children.text: hāhākāraiḥ samullāsair arcanīyo jinālayaḥ || 134 ||
children.translated_text: with joyful exclamations and celebrations — thus should the abode of the <s>Jina</s> be worshipped. (134)

children.text: carmakāraplavamlecchaniyogilubdhakādibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: By leatherworkers, boatmen, <s>mlecchas</s> (barbarians), outcasts, hunters, and the like —

children.text: dūrāt pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vandya eva jinālayaḥ || 135 ||
children.translated_text: having circumambulated from a distance, the abode of the <s>Jina</s> should indeed be saluted. (135)

children.text: evaṃ sarvais tathā lokair dvijādisarvajātibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus by all people of the world, <s>Brahmins</s> and all other castes,

children.text: svasvajātyarhapūjābhiḥ pūjanīyo jinālayaḥ || 136 ||
children.translated_text: the abode of the <s>Jina</s> should be worshipped with worship appropriate to one's own caste. (136)

children.text: evaṃ caranti ye lokā ahorātravrataṃ mudā /
children.translated_text: Those people who thus joyfully practice the day-and-night vow (<s>ahorātravrata</s>) —

children.text: te sarvapāpanirmuktāḥ saṃprayāyur jinālayam || 137 ||
children.translated_text: they, freed from all sins, proceed to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>. (137)

children.text: evaṃ matvā mahārāja māse māse sadāpi ca /
children.translated_text: Knowing this, O great king, month after month, always,

children.text: pūrṇamāsyām ahorātravrataṃ caritum arhasi || 138 ||
children.translated_text: on the full-moon day, you should observe the day-and-night vow. (138)

children.text: viśeṣād aśvinīmāse saṃpūrṇe candramaṇḍale /
children.translated_text: Especially in the month of <s>Āśvina</s>, when the moon's orb is full,

children.text: aśvinībhe tathā puṣyayogayukte raver dine || 139 ||
children.translated_text: when the <s>Āśvinī</s> constellation is joined with the <s>Puṣya</s> conjunction, on a Sunday — (139)

children.text: etadyogasamāyukte mahāparvadine śubhe /
children.translated_text: on that auspicious great festival day endowed with this conjunction,

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ kuryād yathāvidhi samāhitaḥ || 140 ||
children.translated_text: one should perform the day-and-night vow according to the proper rite, with concentration. (140)

children.text: yaḥ karoti dine tasminn ahorātravrataṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: Whoever performs the day-and-night vow on that day —

children.text: tatsahasraguṇaṃ puṇyam āpnuyāt sa pumān dhruvam || 141 ||
children.translated_text: that person will surely obtain a thousandfold merit. (141)

children.text: evaṃ rājann ahorātravratapuṇyaṃ mahattaram /
children.translated_text: Thus, O king, the merit of the day-and-night vow is exceedingly great,

children.text: aprameyam asaṃkhyeyam iti buddhair nigadyate || 142 ||
children.translated_text: immeasurable and incalculable — so it is declared by the <s>Buddhas</s>. (142)

children.text: na hi sa vidyate rājan sarvatra bhuvaneṣv api /
children.translated_text: There exists not, O king, anywhere in all the worlds,

children.text: ahorātravratotpannaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ kurute 'nyathā || 143 ||
children.translated_text: anyone who can make otherwise the merit born from the day-and-night vow. (143)

children.text: yasya śravaṇamātreṇa vimuktaḥ sarvapātakāt /
children.translated_text: By the mere hearing of which one is freed from all sins —

children.text: darśanāt puṇyam āpnoti tathānumodanād api || 144 ||
children.translated_text: By seeing [the caitya] one obtains merit, and likewise by rejoicing [in it]. (Avc 144)

children.text: ye caranti mahārāja vratarājam idaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: Those who, O great king, duly observe this king of <s>vratas</s> (vows) —

children.text: teṣāṃ puṇyapramāṇāni saṃkhyātuṃ ko hi śaknuyāt || 145 ||
children.translated_text: who could be able to reckon the measure of their merit? (Avc 145)

children.text: tatpuṇyasaptabhāgaikaṃ bhāgaṃ rājā samāpnuyāt /
children.translated_text: Of that merit, the king obtains one share among seven,

children.text: tathaikaṃ sarvasattvāś ca tathaikaṃ sādhakā janāḥ || 146 ||
children.translated_text: likewise one share for all beings, and likewise one share for the practitioners. (Avc 146)

children.text: vratinas taccaturbhāgān sarvān te prāpnuvanti hi /
children.translated_text: The observers of the vow obtain all four shares of that [remaining merit];

children.text: etatpuṇyānubhāvais tu sarvatra maṅgalaṃ sadā || 147 ||
children.translated_text: by the power of this merit, there is always auspiciousness everywhere. (Avc 147)

children.text: sarve sattvāḥ sukhāḍhyāś ca bhavanti bodhicāriṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: All beings become rich in happiness and become practitioners of <s>bodhi</s> (awakening);

children.text: evaṃ vijñāya rājendra lokānāṃ hitasādhanam /
children.translated_text: knowing thus, O lord of kings, that this is the means of benefiting the worlds,

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ yūyaṃ kartum arhatha sarvathā || 148 ||
children.translated_text: you should by all means perform the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night vow). (Avc 148)

children.text: iti tena samākhyātaṃ dhīmatā vasubandhunā /
children.translated_text: Thus was it explained by the wise <s>Vasubandhu</s>;

children.text: śrutvā sa indrapṛṣṭas tad vrataṃ kartuṃ samaicchata || 149 ||
children.translated_text: having heard that, <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s> desired to perform the vow. (Avc 149)

children.text: atha sa bhūpatiḥ śrīmān indrapṛṣṭo narādhipaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then that glorious lord of the earth, the king <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s>, sovereign of men,

children.text: sāñjalis taṃ punar natvā vasubandhuṃ tathārthayat || 150 ||
children.translated_text: with joined palms, bowing again to <s>Vasubandhu</s>, entreated him thus: (Avc 150)

children.text: bhadanta sarvavic chāstar bhavadājñāṃ śirovahan /
children.translated_text: "O Venerable One, all-knowing Teacher, bearing your command upon my head,

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ kartum icchāmi sāṃprataṃ khalu || 151 ||
children.translated_text: I wish now indeed to perform the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night vow). (Avc 151)

children.text: bhavāñ chāstā mahāvijñaḥ sarvasattvahitāśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: You are the Teacher, greatly wise, whose intention is the welfare of all beings;

children.text: sarvahitārthasiddhyai tad anujñāṃ pradadātu me || 152 ||
children.translated_text: for the accomplishment of the welfare of all, please grant me your permission." (Avc 152)

children.text: iti tena nṛpendreṇa prārthitaṃ sa mahāmatiḥ /
children.translated_text: When thus entreated by the lord of kings, the great-minded one,

children.text: vasubandhuḥ samākarṇya taṃ bhūpam evam abravīt || 153 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vasubandhu</s>, having listened, spoke thus to that king: (Avc 153)

children.text: sādhu sādhu mahārāja yady evaṃ tvaṃ samicchasi /
children.translated_text: "Well done, well done, O great king! If you so desire,

children.text: tat kuruṣva mahatpuṇyam ahorātravrataṃ mudā || 154 ||
children.translated_text: then perform with joy this great meritorious <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night vow). (Avc 154)

children.text: tatkṛte te mahat puṇyaṃ sarvatrāpi bhavec chubham /
children.translated_text: By performing it, great merit and auspiciousness will be yours everywhere;

children.text: etatpuṇyavipākena saṃbodhiṃ prāpnuyā api || 155 ||
children.translated_text: through the ripening of this merit, you may even attain <s>Saṃbodhi</s> (perfect awakening). (Avc 155)

children.text: iti śāstrā samādiṣṭam indrapṛṣṭaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus instructed by the Teacher, that king <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s>,

children.text: śrutvā taṃ sāñjalir natvā punar evaṃ samabravīt || 156 ||
children.translated_text: having heard, bowing to him with joined palms, spoke again thus: (Avc 156)

children.text: bhadanta kartum icchāmi puṇyakṣetre jinālayam /
kutra puṇyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ tat samādeṣṭum arhati /1151 //
children.translated_text: where is the most meritorious field? Please instruct me regarding that." (Avc 157)
"Venerable One, I wish to build a <s>Jinālaya</s> (temple of the Conqueror) in a field of merit;

children.text: iti tena narendreṇa pṛṣṭe sa sarvavit sudhīḥ /
children.translated_text: When thus asked by the lord of men, the all-knowing, wise one,

children.text: vasubandhur narendraṃ taṃ punar evam upādiśat || 158 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vasubandhu</s>, instructed that lord of men again thus: (Avc 158)

children.text: śṛṇu sādho mahārāja yathā khyātaṃ munīśvaraiḥ /
children.translated_text: "Listen, O noble great king, as it has been declared by the lords of sages;

children.text: tathāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śrutvaivaṃ kartum arhasi || 159 ||
children.translated_text: so shall I tell you — having heard, you should act accordingly. (Avc 159)

children.text: vārāṇasīti vikhyātā sarvabhūmī mahattarī /
children.translated_text: <s>Vārāṇasī</s>, renowned as the greatest of all lands,

children.text: puṇyakṣetraṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ sarvabuddhaiḥ praśaṃsitam || 160 ||
children.translated_text: is a field of merit, a great <s>pīṭha</s> (sacred seat), praised by all <s>Buddhas</s>. (Avc 160)

children.text: tatra yat praṇidhānena prakṛtaṃ karma kāritam /
children.translated_text: Whatever action is performed there through a vow of aspiration,

children.text: tat tatheha paratrāpi sidhyate nānyathā khalu || 161 ||
children.translated_text: that indeed bears fruit here and in the next world — not otherwise. (Avc 161)

children.text: iti vijñāya rājendra tatra gatvā yathāvidhi /
children.translated_text: Knowing this, O lord of kings, having gone there according to the proper rite,

children.text: pratiṣṭhāpya tathā caityam ahorātravrataṃ careḥ || 162 ||
children.translated_text: having established a <s>caitya</s> (shrine), you should observe the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night vow). (Avc 162)

children.text: tathā cet te sadā bhadram ihāmutra bhaved dhruvam /
children.translated_text: If you do so, there will always be good fortune for you, here and hereafter, assuredly;

children.text: kramād bodhicarīḥ pūrya saṃbuddhapadam āpsyasi || 163 ||
children.translated_text: gradually fulfilling the practices of <s>bodhi</s> (awakening), you will attain the station of a <s>Sambuddha</s> (Perfectly Awakened One). (Avc 163)

children.text: iti tena samādiṣṭaṃ guruṇā vasubandhunā /
children.translated_text: Thus instructed by his guru <s>Vasubandhu</s>,

children.text: śrutvā sa bhūpatiḥ śrīmāṃs tatheti cānvamodata || 164 ||
children.translated_text: having heard, that glorious king assented, saying 'So be it,' and rejoiced. (Avc 164)

children.text: tataḥ sa indrapṛṣṭas taṃ vasubandhuṃ guruṃ puraḥ /
children.translated_text: Then <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s>, placing <s>Vasubandhu</s> his guru before him,

children.text: kṛtvā tataḥ samāgatya vārāṇasīm upācarat || 165 ||
children.translated_text: set out from there and proceeded to <s>Vārāṇasī</s>. (Avc 165)

children.text: tatra prāpya sa bhūmīndro nirīkṣya śubhabhūtale /
children.translated_text: Having arrived there, that lord of the earth, inspecting the auspicious ground,

children.text: ādau bhūśodhanaṃ kṛtvā vāstunāgaṃ parīkṣya ca || 166 ||
children.translated_text: first performed the purification of the earth and examined the <s>Vāstunāga</s> (site-serpent). (Avc 166)

children.text: vihāraṃ vidhivat kṛtvā tathā caityaṃ jinālayam /
children.translated_text: Having duly constructed a <s>vihāra</s> (monastery) and likewise a <s>caitya</s> (shrine), a temple of the <s>Jina</s> (Conqueror),

children.text: triratnaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi sadābhajat || 167 ||
children.translated_text: and having established the <s>Triratna</s> (Three Jewels), he always worshipped according to the rite. (Avc 167)

children.text: tatra tena yathādiṣṭaṃ guruṇā vasubandhunā /
children.translated_text: There, as instructed by his guru <s>Vasubandhu</s>,

children.text: tathā sa nararājendras tad vrataṃ kartum ārabhat || 168 ||
children.translated_text: that lord among kings of men began to perform the vow. (Avc 168)

children.text: tataś ca vidhivad dhṛtvā sabhāryaḥ sa nṛpādhipaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, having duly observed it together with his wife, that sovereign of men,

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ kṛtvā tac caityaṃ vidhinārcayat || 169 ||
children.translated_text: having performed the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night vow), worshipped that <s>caitya</s> according to the rite. (Avc 169)

children.text: tat samāpya punas tatra dīpaṃkaraṃ sasāṃghikam /
children.translated_text: Having completed that, he then invited <s>Dīpaṃkara</s> together with the <s>Saṃgha</s> (community),

children.text: saṃnimantrya yathārhena bhojanena samārcayat || 170 ||
children.translated_text: and worshipped them with a fitting meal. (Avc 170)

children.text: tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālaś ciraṃ tac caityam ādarāt /
children.translated_text: Then that protector of the earth, having served that <s>caitya</s> reverently for a long time

children.text: sevitvā satsukhaṃ bhuktvā yayau cānte jinālayam || 171 ||
children.translated_text: and having enjoyed true happiness, went at the end to the abode of the <s>Jina</s> (Conqueror). (Avc 171)

children.text: ity evaṃ tan mahat puṇyam ahorātravratodbhavam /
children.translated_text: Thus, this great merit born of the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night vow)

children.text: aprameyam asaṃkhyeyaṃ sarvabuddhaiḥ pracakṣyate || 172 ||
children.translated_text: is declared by all <s>Buddhas</s> to be immeasurable and incalculable. (Avc 172)

children.text: tathā yuṣmābhir apy atra tad ahorātrasaṃvaram /
children.translated_text: Likewise, you too should observe that <s>Ahorātra</s>-observance (day-and-night observance),

children.text: dhṛtvā caityaṃ samabhyarcya sevitavyaṃ sadādarāt || 173 ||
children.translated_text: and having worshipped the <s>caitya</s>, you should always attend [upon it] with reverence. (Avc 173)

children.text: tathā vo maṅgalaṃ nityam ihāmutra bhaved dhruvam /
children.translated_text: Thus there will always be auspiciousness for you, here and hereafter, assuredly;

children.text: kramād bodhiṃ samāsādya nirvṛtīpadam āpsyatha || 174 ||
children.translated_text: gradually attaining <s>bodhi</s> (awakening), you will reach the state of <s>nirvṛti</s> (final liberation). (Avc 174)

children.text: ity ādiṣṭaṃ munīndreṇa śrutvā te bhikṣavo mudā /
children.translated_text: Thus instructed by the lord of sages, those <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks), with joy,

children.text: tathety abhyanumoditvā tad vrataṃ kartum īṣire || 175 ||
children.translated_text: having assented saying 'So be it,' desired to perform that vow. (Avc 175)

children.text: tatas te bhikṣavo bhūyaḥ śāstāraṃ taṃ munīśvaram /
children.translated_text: Then those <s>bhikṣus</s>, once more to that Teacher, lord of sages,

children.text: kṛtāñjalipuṭā natvā papracchur evam ādarāt || 176 ||
children.translated_text: with palms joined in reverence, bowing down, asked thus respectfully: (Avc 176)

children.text: bhagavan bhavatādiṣṭam indrapṛṣṭena yat kṛtam /
children.translated_text: "<s>Bhagavān</s>, all that was instructed by you and performed by <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s> —

children.text: tat sarvaṃ śrutam asmābhiḥ punaḥ śrotuṃ samiṣyate || 177 ||
children.translated_text: all that we have heard; [yet] we wish to hear further. (Avc 177)

children.text: kena kena tathā pūrvaṃ kṛtam etad vratottamam /
children.translated_text: By whom else was this supreme vow formerly performed,

children.text: ahorātraṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ tat samādeṣṭum arhati || 178 ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Ahorātra</s> (day-and-night) [vow] of great merit? Please instruct us regarding that." (Avc 178)

children.text: iti tair bhikṣubhiḥ pṛṣṭe bhagavān sa munīśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: When thus asked by those <s>bhikṣus</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s>, that lord of sages,

children.text: tān bhikṣūn sāṃghikān sarvān samālokyaivam abravīt || 179 ||
children.translated_text: surveying all those <s>bhikṣus</s> together with the <s>Saṃgha</s>, spoke thus: (Avc 179)

children.text: śṛṇudhvaṃ bhikṣavaḥ sarve tathānyaiś ca kṛtaṃ purā /
children.translated_text: "Listen, all you <s>bhikṣus</s>! What was done formerly by others as well —

children.text: tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ paribodhane || 180 ||
children.translated_text: all that I shall narrate for your instruction. (Avc 180)

children.text: purā svarge tathendreṇa pratiṣṭhāpya jinālayam /
children.translated_text: Formerly in heaven, <s>Indra</s> (Śakra), having established a temple of the <s>Jina</s>,

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ kṛtvā vidhivac caityam ārcayat || 181 ||
children.translated_text: performed the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> and duly worshipped the <s>caitya</s>. (Avc 181)

children.text: etatpuṇyānubhāvaiḥ sa sarvapāramitāḥ kramāt /
children.translated_text: By the power of this merit, he gradually fulfilled all the <s>pāramitās</s> (perfections),

children.text: pūrayitvā mahāsattvo bodhisattvo 'bhavat sudhīḥ || 182 ||
children.translated_text: and the wise great being became a <s>Bodhisattva</s>. (Avc 182)
{Manuscript E adds: Then, in the course of time, another became king of the gods; having enjoyed the happiness of the king of gods, he moves about in this [world] as he pleases. (Avc 182*)}

children.text: pātāle ca mahāvīro daityendro 'bhūn maharddhimān /
children.translated_text: And in the netherworld (<s>Pātāla</s>), there was a great hero, a lord of the <s>Daityas</s> (demons), of great supernatural power,

children.text: nirghoṣadamano nāma devalokabhayaṃkaraḥ || 183 ||
children.translated_text: named <s>Nirghoṣadamana</s>, terrifying to the world of the gods. (Avc 183)

children.text: tena jitvā balenāpi trailokyaṃ svavaśīkṛtam /
children.translated_text: By him, the three worlds were conquered by force and brought under his control;

children.text: sarve 'pi lokapālāś ca parājitya vaśīkṛtāḥ || 184 ||
children.translated_text: all the <s>Lokapālas</s> (World-Guardians) too were defeated and subjugated. (Avc 184)

children.text: tadā sa pṛthivīṃ gatvā vārāṇasīm upācarat /
children.translated_text: Then he went to the earth and proceeded to <s>Vārāṇasī</s>;

children.text: indrapṛṣṭavihārasthaṃ caityaṃ dṛṣṭvānvamodata || 185 ||
children.translated_text: seeing the <s>caitya</s> situated in the <s>vihāra</s> of <s>Indrapṛṣṭha</s>, he rejoiced. (Avc 185)

children.text: tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya taṃ caityaṃ vidhinārcayat /
children.translated_text: Then, having circumambulated that <s>caitya</s>, he worshipped it according to the rite;

children.text: kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhutvā prārthayad evam ānataḥ || 186 ||
children.translated_text: with palms joined, having prostrated, he prayed thus with bowed head: (Avc 186)

children.text: yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā saṃsthāpya svavaśe jagat /
children.translated_text: "Having enjoyed happiness as long as I live, and having established the world under my control,

children.text: saṃbuddhaśaraṇaṃ gatvā prānte yāyāṃ jinālayam || 187 ||
children.translated_text: taking refuge in the <s>Sambuddha</s> (Perfectly Awakened One), may I at the end go to the abode of the <s>Jina</s>." (Avc 187)

children.text: ity evaṃ praṇidhiṃ dhṛtvā natvā taṃ ca jinālayam /
children.translated_text: Having thus made his aspiration (<s>praṇidhi</s>) and having bowed to that temple of the <s>Jina</s>,

children.text: tata eva yayau svargaṃ daityendraḥ sa maharddhikaḥ || 188 ||
children.translated_text: from there that lord of the <s>Daityas</s>, of great supernatural power, went to heaven. (Avc 188)

children.text: tatrāpi caityam ālokya śakreṇa sthāpitaṃ purā /
children.translated_text: There too, seeing the <s>caitya</s> formerly established by <s>Śakra</s> (Indra),

children.text: natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vidhinā ca samārcayat || 189 ||
children.translated_text: having bowed and circumambulated it, he worshipped it according to the rite. (Avc 189)

children.text: tathaiva praṇidhiṃ kṛtvā natvā ca sāñjalir mudā /
children.translated_text: Having likewise made his aspiration, having bowed with joined palms in joy,

children.text: tataś ca sa samāgatya pātāle svaṃ gṛhaṃ yayau || 190 ||
children.translated_text: he then returned and went to his own dwelling in the netherworld (<s>Pātāla</s>). (Avc 190)

children.text: {E has the following addition after 190 b on folio 13.
children.translated_text: {Manuscript E has the following addition after 190b on folio 13:

children.text: etatpuṇyānubhāvena daityendro 'sau maharddhikaḥ /
children.translated_text: By the power of this merit, that lord of the <s>Daityas</s>, of great supernatural power,

children.text: śakrāsanaṃ tadā tatra labdhavān vigrahair balaiḥ // Avc_190* //
children.translated_text: then obtained the throne of <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) there through his battles and powers. (Avc 190*)

children.text: tadāsa devarājendraḥ saṃjñātvāho tam āgatam /
children.translated_text: Then the king of the gods, learning of his arrival, said:

children.text: idānīṃ kiṃprakāreṇa vijayiṣyāmi dānavaṃ /
children.translated_text: 'How shall I now conquer the <s>Dānava</s> (demon)?

children.text: mamāśrameṣu nirghoṣadamano nāmāsau sthitaḥ // Avc_190** //
children.translated_text: The one named <s>Nirghoṣadamana</s> is stationed in my abodes.' (Avc 190**)

children.text: iti dhyātvā sa śakraḥ bhuvane trāyastriṃśake /
children.translated_text: Thus reflecting, that <s>Śakra</s>, in the world of the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> (Thirty-Three Gods),

children.text: prāktanair devarājendraiḥ pūjārthaṃ caityaṃ sthāpitaḥ // Avc_190*** //
children.translated_text: [recalled that] a <s>caitya</s> had been established for worship by former kings of the gods. (Avc 190***)

children.text: tasmin caitye ahorātravrataṃ kuryāṃ yathāvidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: 'I shall perform the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (day-and-night vow) at that <s>caitya</s> according to the rite;

children.text: tadupāyena dharmeṇa vijayiṣye suradviṣaṃ // Avc_190**** //
children.translated_text: by that means, through the <s>Dharma</s>, I shall conquer the enemy of the gods.' (Avc 190****)

children.text: śrutaṃ mayāsti saddharmaṃ tad eṣo 'pi ca tadvrataiḥ /
children.translated_text: 'I have heard the true <s>Dharma</s>; and he too, through those vows,

children.text: svarge surasahāyena gato 'sau maghavaṃuiīṃ // Avc_190***** //
children.translated_text: went to the realm of <s>Maghavān</s> (Indra) in heaven with the help of the gods.' (Avc 190*****)

children.text: tadanantare ca devendraḥ mahārheṇa vratārcanaṃ /
children.translated_text: Thereupon the lord of the gods, with most worthy vow-worship,

children.text: atīva susamudāyena kṛtavāñ ca jinālaye // Avc_190****** //
children.translated_text: performed [the rite] with a most excellent assembly at the temple of the <s>Jina</s>. (Avc 190******)

children.text:
tadanantare 'pi nirghoṣadamano 'suranirjitaḥ /
vinā yuddhena nirjityāsuraṃ bhūmyavatāritaḥ // Avc_190******* //}
children.translated_text: Thereupon, <s>Nirghoṣadamana</s>, having conquered the <s>Asura</s> without battle, subjugated the demon and brought him down to earth. [Avc 190]

children.text: tatra sa daityarājendro yathāvidhi jinālayam /
children.translated_text: There that lord of <s>Daitya</s>-kings, according to the proper rites, [built] a <s>Jina</s>-temple (<s>jinālaya</s>),

children.text: mahac caityaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya satkṛtya vidhinārcayat || 191 ||
children.translated_text: and having established a great <s>caitya</s> (shrine), honored and worshipped it with due ceremony. [Avc 191]

children.text: tataś cāpi sa daityendro yathāvidhi samārabhan /
children.translated_text: Then that lord of <s>Daityas</s>, having duly undertaken

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ dhṛtvā tac caityaṃ samapūjayat || 192 ||
children.translated_text: the day-and-night vow (<s>ahorātravrata</s>), worshipped that <s>caitya</s>. [Avc 192]

children.text: tatraivaṃ praṇidhiṃ kṛtvā so 'surendro mahāmatiḥ /
children.translated_text: There, having made this aspiration, that lord of <s>Asuras</s>, of great wisdom,

children.text: sarvadā vidhinābhyarcya bheje nityaṃ mahotsavaiḥ || 193 ||
children.translated_text: always worshipping with due rites, celebrated with constant great festivals. [Avc 193]

children.text: tathā sa suciraṃ bhuktvā yāvajjīvaṃ mahāsukham /
children.translated_text: Thus, having enjoyed great happiness for a very long time, as long as he lived,

children.text: tac caityaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yayau tathā jinālayam || 194 ||
children.translated_text: having taken that <s>caitya</s> as his refuge, he went to the <s>Jina</s>-abode. [Avc 194]

children.text: tathānye nāgarājāś ca tac caityaṃ samupāśritāḥ /
children.translated_text: Likewise, other <s>Nāga</s>-kings, having resorted to that <s>caitya</s>,

children.text: ahorātravrataṃ dhṛtvā satkṛtya vidhinārcayan || 195 ||
children.translated_text: observing the day-and-night vow, honored and worshipped it with due rites. [Avc 195]

children.text: tathā sarve 'pi te nāgā yāvajjīvaṃ mahat sukham /
children.translated_text: Thus all those <s>Nāgas</s> too, having enjoyed great happiness as long as they lived,

children.text: bhuktvā puṇyānubhāvaiś ca prānte yayur jinālayam || 196 ||
